messages:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a small re-group of the left nav (move 'Models' next to 'Deployments', collapse 'Monitoring' under Observability). Also thought: canonical deep links for model versions and a URL contract so external teams can bookmark specific model+version. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/console-nav
kevin: +1 on regrouping. Main ask: what happens to existing permalinks? we have infra links in docs that point to /models/:id — need redirects or stable slugs.
olivia: UX concern: if we move Models, do we keep breadcrumb semantics? current crumbs are Project > Models > Model > Version — users expect that. We should preserve that path in the breadcrumb even if the left nav groups change.
samir: Routing note: prefer path-based canonical URLs over hashes for shareability and crawlers. Example proposal:

```
/p/:projectId/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId
/p/:projectId/deployments/:deploymentId
```

Query params for UI-only state: `?side=collapsed&panel=metrics` so deep link is stable but UI state is optional.
jordan: A11y: ensure that when a deep link opens to a model version the focus lands on the primary heading and not buried in the side nav. Also add `aria-current="page"` on active nav items and a skip link to main content.
a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) aria-current present on active item 2) skip to main 3) focus management on load 4) readable link text for screen readers 5) test with keyboard nav
kevin: Redirect plan idea: keep old paths working for 1 year with 301 -> new path. Add a small compatibility layer in routing middleware to map legacy slugs to new canonical ids.
maya: Decision draft: 1) adopt path-based canonical routes as Samir's examples 2) UI-only state via query params (no hash routing) 3) redirect legacy /models/:id -> /p/:projectId/models/:modelId for 12 months 4) update breadcrumbs to reflect logical hierarchy independent of left nav grouping
olivia: One more UX thought — when users land from an external deep link, show a transient banner: "You're viewing Model X via a direct link" with an anchor to open nav. Helps orientation.
samir: Implementation note: router needs to support route aliases for canary rollouts. We'll add `routeAliases` table so we can fallback to previous shapes if a rollout fails.
maya: @kevin / @samir can you own the routing middleware changes? @jordan can you own the a11y checklist + tests? I'll update the Figma and write the copy for the banner.
kevin: I can take the middleware. I'll draft a small migration plan and share timings.
jordan: I'll run the checklist and add keyboard/screenreader notes to the PR template.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post an updated Figma and a short RFC with route examples and redirect window later today. :thumbsup:
